sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 - API Pricing & Benchmarks | OpenRouter
sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 is a large-scale mixture-of-experts model from DeepSeek. $0.435 per million input tokens, $0.87 per million output tokens. 1,048,576 token context window, maximum output of 384,000 tokens. Includes independent benchmarks from Artificial Analysis.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 is an AI model released by DeepSeek on Thursday, Aug 13 2026, 13 days after DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731. Benchmark results (shown below) cover AutomationBench, Terminal-Bench 2.1, Toolathlon-Verified, CyberGym, and Humanity's Last Exam.
